commit_scope: Root-cause and heal the news organ's production timeout (the request awaited every source in sequence at 15 s each); surface the voice's refusal reason in this body's event door; add the launchd carrier for the kernel steward; union-merge ledgers.
evidence_refs: Root cause, read in api/app/services/news_ingestion_service.py: fetch_feeds awaited each active RSS source one after another inside the request with a 15 s client timeout, so an empty or stale cache meant a request longer than the edge allows; observed live 2026-10-19 as curl /api/news/feed timing out at 15 s with 0 bytes.

Heal: sources fetched concurrently (asyncio.gather) with a 5 s per-source bound; a fresh cache answers at once; a stale cache answers at once and refreshes behind the request (one shared background task); an empty cache waits at most news.first_fetch_wait_seconds (6 s) and answers with what arrived. api/tests/test_external_presence.py: 9 passed.

The event door prints the voice's refusal reason from the result's reason slot (fcnv-none index 7): model-queued behind another admission, or the memory governor's hold, now visible in the reading line.

scripts/install_kernel_steward.sh: a thin launchd carrier (every 120 s, RunAtLoad) running the kernel's observe/kernel-steward-run.bml act 1 from the runner checkout with a seed-freshness line; the logic is Form (coherence-kernel: the kernel steward, band 15).
.gitattributes: docs/system_audit/*.jsonl merge=union, so ledger rows appended on both sides merge as the union — tonight's event-transmute ledger conflict was this class.

Production deploys today failed on a timed-out roll-forward and a missing gate/form-cli-build-run.bml inside the image build; a sibling's PRs on Form-owned image sources are the heal in progress, so the live observation of /api/news/feed follows that rollout.

local_validation.summary: 9 external-presence tests pass with the bounded fetch; the event door preflights clean in the kernel; the carrier script is syntax-checked and mirrors the heartbeat's plist shape.
